title.tr: Asma Allah al-Husna (Allah’s most beautiful names)

items.ar: الله
items.tr: Allah

items.ar: «الله» هو المعبود الحق وحده، وأصل الاسم من «الإله» أي المعبود.
items.tr: Allah alone is the true object of worship. The name derives from al-ilah, meaning the one who is worshiped.

items.ar: وهو الاسم الجامع الذي تُضاف إليه سائر الأسماء الحسنى، فمن عرفه أفرده بالعبادة وحده.
items.tr: It is the comprehensive name to which all the other most beautiful names are ascribed. Whoever knows Him singles Him out alone in worship.

items.ar: فمن خصائص هذا الاسم أنه الأصل لجميع أسماء الله الحسنى، وسائر الأسماء مضافة إليه ويوصف بها
items.tr: One distinctive feature of this name is that it is the foundation of all Allah's most beautiful names. All the other names are ascribed to it and describe Him.

items.ar: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ فَٱدْعُوهُ بِهَا
items.tr:
Full-verse context (7:180):
And to Allāh belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names.[425] They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.
[425] i.e., use them improperly or deny them.

items.ar: الأحد
items.tr: Al-Ahad

items.ar: «الأحد» هو الذي لا نظير له ولا كفؤ من أي وجه من الوجوه.
items.tr: Al-Ahad is the One who has no counterpart or equal in any respect.

items.ar: فلا يماثله أحد في شيء من صفاته، ولا تبلغ العقول كنه كماله.
items.tr: No one resembles Him in any of His attributes, and minds cannot comprehend the full reality of His perfection.

items.ar: وهما اسمان دالان على أحدية الله ووحدانيته، أي أنه سبحانه هو المتفرد بصفات المجد والجلال، المتوحد بنعوت العظمة والكبرياء والجمال
items.tr: These are two names indicating Allah's absolute oneness and uniqueness: He alone possesses the attributes of glory and majesty and the qualities of greatness, supreme grandeur and beauty.

items.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
items.tr:
Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,[2011]
[2011] Alone, without another, indivisible with absolute and permanent unity and distinct from all else. The one and only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes and deeds.

items.ar: الأعلى هو الذي ليس فوقه شيء، وله العلوّ المطلق من كلّ وجه.
items.tr: Al-Ala is the One above whom there is nothing. His highness is absolute in every respect.

items.ar: والإيمان بعلوّه يورث العبد تعظيمًا لربّه وذلًّا بين يديه وإخلاصًا في عبادته.
items.tr: Believing in His highness produces reverence for one's Lord, humility before Him and sincerity in worshiping Him.

items.ar: والإيمان بعلو الله على خلقه يورث العبد تعظيماً لله وذلاًّ بين يديه، وانكساراً له، وتنزيهاً له عن النقائص والعيوب، وإخلاصاً في عبادته، وبعداً عن اتخاذ الأنداد والشّركاء
items.tr: Believing that Allah is above His creation produces reverence for Allah, humility and submission before Him, declaring Him free of shortcomings and defects, sincerity in worshiping Him, and avoidance of taking rivals and partners.

items.ar: الأكرمُ صيغةُ مبالغة من الكرم؛ فهو سبحانه أكرم من كل كريم، ولم يرد هذا الاسم إلا في موضع واحد.
items.tr: Al-Akram is an intensive form of karam (nobility and generosity). He, glorified is He, is more generous than every generous one. This name occurs in only one place.

items.ar: والكرمُ عنده ليس مجرّد العطاء، بل هو لفظٌ جامع لكل المحاسن والمحامد.
items.tr: In His case, karam (nobility and generosity) does not mean giving alone; it encompasses every fine and praiseworthy quality.

items.ar: ولفظ «الكرم» لفظ جامع للمحاسن والمحامد، لا يراد به مجرد الإعطاء، بل الإعطاء من تمام معناه
items.tr: The word karam (nobility and generosity) encompasses fine and praiseworthy qualities. It does not mean giving alone; rather, giving is part of its complete meaning.

items.ar: «الإله» هو المعبود، والألوهية وصفه الذي انفرد به فلا يشاركه فيه أحد.
items.tr: Al-Ilah means the One who is worshiped. Uluhiyyah (divinity and the right to worship) is His exclusive attribute, shared by no one.

items.ar: ومقتضاه في حق العبد أن يعبده وحده، فلا يصرف شيئا من عبادته لغيره.
items.tr: For the servant, this requires worshiping Him alone and directing no act of worship to anyone else.

items.ar: وأمَّا معنى هذا الاسم فأصله «الإله»، وهو بمعنى المعبود
items.tr: As for the meaning of this name, its origin is al-ilah, meaning the one who is worshiped.

items.ar: وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
items.tr: And your god is one God. There is no deity [worthy of worship] except Him, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

items.ar: الأول
items.tr: Al-Awwal

items.ar: الأوَّلُ هو الذي ليس قبله شيء؛ أوليّتُه سابقة على أوليّة كل شيء.
items.tr: Al-Awwal is the One before whom there is nothing. His firstness precedes the firstness of everything.

items.ar: ومن عرف ذلك علم أن فضل الله سابقٌ لكل سبب، فلم يتعلّق قلبه بالأسباب دون مسبِّبها.
items.tr: Whoever knows this knows that Allah's favor precedes every means, so his heart does not attach itself to the means apart from the One who brings them about.

items.ar: فأوليَّةُ الله عزَّ وجلَّ سابقة على أولية كل شيء، وآخريته سبحانه بقاؤه بعد كل شيء، فأحاطت أوليَّتُه وآخريته بالأوائل والأواخر
items.tr: Allah's firstness, mighty and majestic is He, precedes the firstness of everything, and His lastness means that He remains after everything. His firstness and lastness thus encompass all beginnings and endings.

items.ar: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (57:3):
He is the First[1623] and the Last,[1624] the Ascendant[1625] and the Intimate,[1626] and He is, of all things, Knowing.
[1623] Before whom nothing existed. Also, He who is supreme, foremost or uppermost.
[1624] Enduring eternally when nothing else remains.
[1625] Nothing being above Him. Another meaning is "the Apparent," i.e., evident through His creation and revelation.
[1626] Nothing being nearer than Him by way of His knowledge. Another meaning is "the Unapparent," i.e., concealed from man's physical senses.

items.ar: الحديد
items.tr: Al-Hadid

items.ar: اللهمَّ أنت الأوّل فليس قبلك شيء، وأنت الآخر فليس بعدك شيء، وأنت الظّاهر فليس فوقك شيء، وأنت الباطن فليس دونك شيء
items.tr: O Allah, You are Al-Awwal (the First), with nothing before You; Al-Akhir (the Last), with nothing after You; Az-Zahir (the Most High), with nothing above You; and Al-Batin (the Inward), with nothing nearer than You.

items.ar: رواه مسلم في «صحيحه» (رقم: ٢٧١٣) من حديث أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه
items.tr: Narrated by Muslim in his Sahih (no. ٢٧١٣), from the hadith of Abu Hurayrah, may Allah be pleased with him

items.ar: الآخر
items.tr: Al-Akhir

items.ar: الآخرُ هو الذي ليس بعده شيء؛ يبقى سبحانه بعد فناء كل شيء.
items.tr: Al-Akhir is the One after whom there is nothing. He, glorified is He, remains after everything perishes.

items.ar: ومعرفتُه تجعل العبد يجعله وحده غايته، فلا يركن إلى ما يزول وينقضي.
items.tr: Knowing Him makes a servant take Him alone as his ultimate aim, without relying on what passes away and ends.

items.ar: فما من أول إلا والله قبله، وما من آخر إلا والله بعده، فهو جل وعلا الأول فليس شيء قبله، والآخر فليس شيء بعده، وهذه إحاطة زمانية
items.tr: There is no first except that Allah is before it, and no last except that Allah is after it. He, majestic and exalted is He, is Al-Awwal (the First), with nothing before Him, and Al-Akhir (the Last), with nothing after Him. This is encompassing in time.

items.ar: الظاهر
items.tr: Az-Zahir

items.ar: الظاهرُ هو الذي ليس فوقه شيء؛ له العلوّ والفوقيّة على كل شيء.
items.tr: Az-Zahir is the One above whom there is nothing. He possesses highness and is above everything.

items.ar: ومعرفةُ ظاهريّته توجب حسن توجّه القلب إليه، وتمام الذلّ والخضوع بين يديه.
items.tr: Knowing His being above everything requires the heart to turn properly toward Him, with complete humility and submission before Him.

items.ar: فعلا على كل شيء بظهوره، فهو العلي الأعلى الذي ليس شيء فوقه، استوى على عرشه المجيد، والعرش سقف المخلوقات وأعلاها، والله فوق العرش، فظاهريته سبحانه هي فوقيته وعلوه على كل شيء
items.tr: He is above everything through His being Az-Zahir: He is Al-Ali, Al-Ala, above whom there is nothing. He rose above His glorious Throne; the Throne is the roof and highest point of created things, and Allah is above it. His being Az-Zahir means His being above and exalted over everything.

items.ar: الباطن
items.tr: Al-Batin

items.ar: الباطنُ هو الذي ليس دونه شيء؛ أحاط بكل شيء وقرُب من خلقه حتى كان أقرب إلى العبد من نفسه.
items.tr: Al-Batin is the One nearer than whom there is nothing. He encompasses everything and is so near His creation that He is nearer to the servant than his own self.

items.ar: ومعرفةُ باطنيّته تقتضي تزكية النفس وإصلاح السريرة وتطهير الباطن.
items.tr: Knowing His being Al-Batin requires purifying the soul, rectifying one's inner state and cleansing the inward self.

items.ar: ودنا من كل شيء ببطونه، فبطونه سبحانه إحاطته بكل شيء بحيث يكون أقرب إليه من نفسه، فهو يدلُّ على كمال اطلاعه على السرائر والخفايا، ودقائق الأشياء وخبايا الأمور، كما يدل على كمال قربه ودنوه
items.tr: He is near everything through His being Al-Batin. This means His encompassing everything so that He is nearer to it than its own self. It indicates His perfect knowledge of secrets, hidden matters, the minutiae of things and concealed affairs, as well as His perfect closeness and nearness.

items.ar: البارئ
items.tr: Al-Bari

items.ar: «البارئ» هو الذي أبرز المخلوقات إلى الوجود بعد العدم.
items.tr: Al-Bari is the One who brings created things into existence from nonexistence.

items.ar: وهذا الوصف خاص به وحده، لا يوصف به مخلوق بحال.
items.tr: This attribute belongs to Him alone; no created being may be described by it under any circumstances.

items.ar: فالبارئ اسم مختص بالله ﷻ فلا يجوز أن يطلق على غيره بأي حال لأنَّ البرْأَ ـ وهو الإيجاد من العدم ـ أمرٌ مختصٌّ به سبحانه فهو الذي برأ الخليقة وأوجدها من العدم
items.tr: Al-Bari is a name exclusive to Allah, majestic is His glory. It must never be applied to anyone else, because bringing into being from nonexistence belongs exclusively to Him, glorified is He. He originated creation and brought it into existence from nonexistence.

items.ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (59:24):
He is Allāh, the Creator,[1666] the Producer,[1667] the Fashioner;[1668] to Him belong the best names.[1669] Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.[1670]
[1666] i.e., He who destined existence for His creation.
[1667] i.e., He who brings His creation into existence.
[1668] i.e., He who gives every creation its particular form.
[1669] Refer to the final paragraphs of the "Introduction" for a brief discussion of these attributes.
[1670] Refer to footnote in 6:18.

items.ar: الحشر
items.tr: Al-Hashr

items.ar: ومن أظلم ممن ذهب يخلق كخلقي، فليخلقوا ذرة، أو ليخلقوا حبة، أو ليخلقوا شعيرة
items.tr: Who is more unjust than one who sets about creating like My creation? Let them create an ant, or a grain, or a barley grain.

items.ar: في «الصحيحين» من حديث أبي هريرة: «صحيح البخاري» (رقم: ٥٦٠٩)، و«صحيح مسلم» (رقم: ٢١١١)

items.ar: البر
items.tr: Al-Barr

items.ar: البَرُّ هو الذي شمل الكائنات كلَّها ببرّه ومنّه وعطائه؛ واسعُ العطاء دائمُ الإحسان.
items.tr: Al-Barr is the One whose kindness, favor and giving encompass all beings. His giving is vast and His beneficence constant.

items.ar: وبرُّه نوعان: عامٌّ وسِعَ الخلق كلَّهم، وخاصٌّ بمن هداه لدينه ووفّقه لطاعته.
items.tr: His kindness is of two kinds: general, encompassing all creation, and special, for those He guides to His religion and enables to obey Him.

items.ar: أي: الذي شمل الكائنات بأسرها ببره ومنِّه وعطائه، فهو مولي النعم، واسع العطاء، دائم الإحسان، لم يزل ولا يزال بالبر والعطاء موصوفًا، وبالمنِّ والإحسان معروفًا
items.tr: That is, His kindness, favor and giving encompass all beings. He bestows blessings, gives abundantly and does good constantly. He has always been and will always be characterized by kindness and giving, and known for favor and beneficence.

items.ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
items.tr:
Indeed, we used to supplicate[1556] Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
[1556] i.e., worship.

items.ar: البصير
items.tr: Al-Basir

items.ar: البصير هو الذي يرى كلّ شيء مهما دقّ وصغر، لا يحجب بصره ظلامٌ ولا بُعدٌ ولا حجاب.
items.tr: Al-Basir sees everything, however minute and small. Darkness, distance and barriers do not obstruct His sight.

items.ar: ومن أيقن أنّ الله يراه راقب نفسه، فأحسن عبادته وابتعد عن معصيته.
items.tr: Whoever is certain that Allah sees him watches himself, worshiping Him well and avoiding disobedience to Him.

items.ar: الذي يرى جميع المبصرات، ويبصر كل شيء وإن دق وصغر، فيبصر دبيب النملة السوداء على الصخرة الصماء في الليلة الظلماء، ويرى مجاري القوت في أعضائها، ويرى جريان الدم في عروقها
items.tr: He sees everything visible and perceives every thing, however minute and small. He sees a black ant moving on a hard rock on a dark night; He sees nourishment passing through its organs and blood flowing through its veins.

items.ar: وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
items.tr:

items.tr: At-Tawwab enables whomever He wills among His servants to repent, then accepts their repentance.

items.tr: He is the One who turns toward whomever He wills among His servants by enabling them to repent.

Then He turned to them so they could repent. Indeed, Allāh is the Accepting of Repentance,[506] the Merciful.

items.ar: الجبّارُ له ثلاثة معانٍ: القهرُ لكل شيء، وجبرُ الكسير ولطفُه بالمصاب، والعلوُّ على كل شيء.
items.tr: Al-Jabbar has three meanings: subduing everything; mending the broken and showing gentleness to the afflicted; and being exalted above everything.

items.ar: فهو الذي يجبر الكسير، ويغني الفقير، وييسّر العسير، ويجبر قلوب الخاضعين له بفضله.
items.tr: He mends the broken, enriches the poor, makes difficulty easy and, through His favor, mends the hearts of those who submit to Him.

items.ar: الثاني: يرجع إلى لطف الرّحمة والرّأفة، فهو الذي يجبر الكسير، ويغني الفقير، وييسر العسير، ويجبر المريض والمصاب بتوفيقه للصبر وتيسير المعافاة له، مع تعويضه على مصابه أعظم الأجر
items.tr: The second relates to gentle mercy and compassion. He mends the broken, enriches the poor, makes difficulty easy, and restores the sick and afflicted by enabling patience and making recovery easy, while compensating them for their affliction with the greatest reward.

items.ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (59:23):
He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign,[1658] the Pure,[1659] the Perfection,[1660] the Grantor of Security,[1661] the Overseer,[1662] the Exalted in Might,[1663] the Compeller,[1664] the Superior.[1665] Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
[1658] And owner of everything in existence.
[1659] i.e., transcendent above any aspect belonging to His creation. Also, the possessor and grantor of blessings.
[1660] Literally, "Free" from any imperfection. Also, "Peace" or "Soundness."
[1661] And safety, i.e., reassurance that His promise is always fulfilled. Also, He who bestows faith.
[1662] i.e., who observes, guards and protects. Also, "the Criterion."
[1663] Refer to footnote in 2:129.
[1664] Whose irresistible force is without limitation; the one above all things who compels the creation to be as He wills it. Also, "the Amender" or "the Rectifier" who repairs, restores, completes or sets something right once again, out of His mercy.
[1665] Supreme, complete and perfect in His essence, attributes and actions.

items.ar: الحافظُ هو الذي يحفظ المخلوقات من سماء وأرض وما فيهما، فلا تزول ولا تميد ولا يسقط شيء على شيء.
items.tr: Al-Hafiz preserves created things: the heavens, earth and all within them, so that they do not disappear, sway or fall upon one another.

items.ar: ويحفظ عباده مما يكرهون: حفظًا عامًّا للخلق كلِّهم، وحفظًا خاصًّا لأوليائه في دينهم وإيمانهم.
items.tr: He protects His servants from what they dislike: a general protection for all creation, and a special protection for His devoted servants in their religion and iman (faith).

items.ar: الثاني: أنه تعالى الحافظ للمخلوقات من سماء وأرض وما فيهما، لتبقى مدة بقائها، فلا تزول ولا تَدْثُر ولا تميد ولا يسقط شيء على شيء، ولا يثقله ولا يعجزه شيء من ذلك
items.tr: The second: He Most High preserves created things, the heavens, earth and all within them, so that they remain for their appointed duration. They do not disappear, perish, sway or fall upon one another. None of this burdens Him or exceeds His ability.

items.ar: فَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَٰفِظًا وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
items.tr:

items.tr: Al-Hasib is the All-Sufficient, who suffices His servants in all concerns of their religion and worldly life, facilitates everything they need and wards off everything they dislike.

items.tr: Al-Hafiz is the One whose knowledge encompasses everything. Nothing is absent from Him, and He is never affected by forgetfulness.

items.tr: He preserves creation's deeds, words and intentions in writing, then recompenses them with His bounty and justice.

items.tr: The first is preserving, by His knowledge, all things known: none of them is absent from Him. Its opposite is forgetfulness, which Allah has declared Himself free of because His knowledge and preservation are perfect.

items.tr: Al-Haqq is the One about whom there is no doubt or uncertainty: concerning His essence, names, attributes or uluhiyyah (divinity and the right to worship).

items.tr: He alone is rightfully worshiped; none besides Him is rightfully worshiped. His statements, promise and meeting Him are all true.

items.ar: الحكيم
items.tr: Al-Hakim

items.ar: الحكيمُ هو الذي له كمال الحكمة في خلقه وأمره وشرعه؛ يضع الأشياء مواضعها وينزلها منازلها.
items.tr: Al-Hakim possesses perfect wisdom in His creation, commands and legislation. He puts things in their proper places and positions.

items.ar: فلا يتوجّه إلى حكمته سؤال ولا يقدح فيها مقال؛ خلق كل شيء بأحسن نظام وأتمّ إتقان.
items.tr: No objection can be directed against His wisdom or statement undermine it. He created everything with the best order and fullest precision.

items.ar: أمَّا كمال الحكمة فبثبوت الحكمة له سبحانه في خلقه وفي أمره وشرعه، حيث يضع الأشياء مواضعها وينزلها منازلها، ولا يتوجه إليه سؤال ولا يقدح في حكمته مقال
items.tr: His perfect wisdom means that wisdom is established for Him, glorified is He, in His creation, commands and legislation. He puts things in their proper places and positions; no objection can be directed against Him or statement undermine His wisdom.

items.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (6:18):
And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise,[296] the Aware.[297]
[296] Whose wisdom includes precise, perfect and absolute knowledge of all realities and outcomes, according to which He decrees and causes circumstances and occurrences.
[297] Fully acquainted and familiar with every hidden thought, intent and condition of His servants.

items.ar: الأنعام
items.tr: Al-Anam

items.ar: إن الله تعالى هو الحكم وإليه الحكم، فلِمَ تكنى أبا الحكم؟
items.tr: Allah Most High is Al-Hakam (the Judge), and judgment belongs to Him. Why, then, are you called Abu al-Hakam?

items.ar: رواه أبو داود والنسائي والبخاري في «الأدب المفرد»: «سنن أبي داود» (رقم: ٤٩٥٥)، و«سنن النسائي» (رقم: ٥٣٨٧)، و«الأدب المفرد» (رقم: ٨١١)
items.tr: Narrated by Abu Dawud, An-Nasai and Al-Bukhari in Al-Adab al-Mufrad: Sunan Abi Dawud (no. ٤٩٥٥), Sunan an-Nasai (no. ٥٣٨٧) and Al-Adab al-Mufrad (no. ٨١١)

items.ar: وصحّحه الألباني في «صحيح الأدب المفرد» (رقم: ٦٢٣)
items.tr: Al-Albani graded it sahih (authentic) in Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad (no. ٦٢٣).

items.ar: الحليم
items.tr: Al-Halim

items.ar: الحليمُ هو الذي لا يعجل على عباده بالعقوبة على ذنوبهم ومعاصيهم، بل يمهلهم كي يتوبوا.
items.tr: Al-Halim does not hasten to punish His servants for their sins and disobedience; He gives them respite so they may repent.

items.ar: يرى من يعصيه ويكفر به فيحلم عنه ويوالي عليه النعم؛ وحلمُه عن علم وقدرة لا عن عجز.
items.tr: He sees those who disobey and disbelieve in Him, yet treats them with forbearance and continues bestowing blessings upon them. His forbearance rests on knowledge and power, not incapacity.

items.ar: ومعناه: أي: الذي لا يعجل على عباده بعقوبتهم على ذنوبهم ومعاصيهم، يرى عباده وهم يكفرون به ويعصونه، وهو يحلم عليهم فيؤخر وينظر ويؤجل ولا يعجل
items.tr: Its meaning is that He does not hasten to punish His servants for their sins and disobedience. He sees His servants disbelieving in Him and disobeying Him, yet He treats them with forbearance, delaying, granting respite and postponing rather than hastening.

items.ar: وَأَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (2:235):
There is no blame upon you for that to which you [indirectly] allude concerning a proposal to women or for what you conceal within yourselves. Allāh knows that you will have them in mind. But do not promise them secretly except for saying a proper saying. And do not determine to undertake a marriage contract until the decreed period[93] reaches its end. And know that Allāh knows what is within yourselves, so beware of Him. And know that Allāh is Forgiving and Forbearing.
[93] The ʿiddah (bereavement period) after the death of a husband.

items.ar: الحميد
items.tr: Al-Hamid

items.ar: الحميدُ هو الذي له الحمد كلُّه، المحمود في ذاته وأسمائه وصفاته وأفعاله وأحكامه.
items.tr: Al-Hamid is the One to whom all praise belongs, praised in His essence, names, attributes, acts and judgments.

items.ar: فحمدُه سببُ كل شيء وغايتُه، ونعمُه التي لا تُحصى توجب على العبد حمده وشكره.
items.tr: Praising Him is the cause and goal of everything. His countless blessings oblige the servant to praise and thank Him.

items.ar: أي: الذي له الحمد كله، المحمود في ذاته وأسمائه وصفاته، فله من الأسماء أحسنها، ومن الصفات أكملها، فالحمد أوسع الصفات وأعم المدائح، وأعظم الثناء
items.tr: That is, all praise belongs to Him. He is praised in His essence, names and attributes. His names are the most beautiful and His attributes the most perfect. Praise is the broadest attribute, the most comprehensive commendation and the greatest tribute.

items.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
items.tr: O mankind, you are those in need of Allāh, while Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

items.tr: Fatir

items.ar: الحي
items.tr: Al-Hayy

items.ar: «الحي» أي أن لله حياة كاملة، لم يسبقها عدم ولا يلحقها زوال.
items.tr: Al-Hayy means that Allah possesses perfect life, neither preceded by nonexistence nor followed by cessation.

items.ar: وهي حياة تستلزم كمال صفاته من علمه وسمعه وبصره وقدرته.
items.tr: This life entails the perfection of His attributes of knowledge, hearing, sight and power.

items.ar: واسمه تبارك وتعالى: «الحيّ» فيه إثبات الحياة صفةً لله، وهي حياةٌ كاملة ليست مسبوقةً بعدم، ولا يلحقها زوالٌ وفناء، ولا يعتريها نقصٌ وعيب
items.tr: His name Al-Hayy, blessed and exalted is He, affirms life as an attribute of Allah: perfect life, not preceded by nonexistence, not followed by cessation or annihilation, and unaffected by deficiency or defect.

items.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ
items.tr:
Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining.[114]
[114] See footnotes to 2:255.

items.ar: اللّهمّ لك أسلمتُ، وبك آمنتُ، وعليك توكلتُ، وإليك أنبتُ، وبك خاصمتُ، اللهم إني أعوذ بعزَّتك، لا إله إلَّا أنت أنْ تُضلَّني، أنت الحيُّ الذي لا يموت، والجنُّ والإنس يموتون
items.tr: O Allah, to You I submit, in You I believe, upon You I rely, to You I turn and by You I contend. O Allah, I seek refuge in Your might, none is worthy of worship except You, from Your leading me astray. You are Al-Hayy (the Ever-Living), who does not die, while jinn (unseen beings) and humans die.

items.ar: متفق عليه: «صحيح البخاري» (رقم: ٦٩٤٨)، و«صحيح مسلم» (رقم: ٢٧١٧) ـ واللفظ له ـ من حديث ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما
items.tr: Agreed upon: Sahih al-Bukhari (no. ٦٩٤٨) and Sahih Muslim (no. ٢٧١٧), whose wording this is, from Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with them both

items.ar: القيوم
items.tr: Al-Qayyum

items.ar: «القيوم» أي القائم بنفسه، الغني عن خلقه، المقيم لهم بتدبيره.
items.tr: Al-Qayyum is self-subsisting, independent of His creation, and sustains them through His governance.

items.ar: فكل ما في الكون مفتقر إليه، لا قوام له طرفة عين بغيره.
items.tr: Everything in the universe needs Him and cannot subsist without Him even for the blink of an eye.

items.ar: واسمه تبارك وتعالى «القيُّوم» فيه إثبات القيُّوميَّة صفةً لله، وهي كونه سبحانه قائما بنفسه مقيما لخلقه، فهو اسم دالٌّ على أمرين
items.tr: His name Al-Qayyum, blessed and exalted is He, affirms self-subsistence and sustaining as an attribute of Allah: He, glorified is He, subsists by Himself and sustains His creation. It is a name indicating two matters.

items.ar: وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (20:111):
And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining.[858] And he will have failed who carries injustice.[859]
[858] See footnotes describing these attributes in 2:255.
[859] i.e., sin or wrongdoing towards Allāh or any of His creation.

items.ar: طه
items.tr: Ta Ha

items.ar: يا حيُّ يا قيُّوم برحمتك أستغيث
items.tr: Ya Hayy (Ever-Living), Ya Qayyum (Sustainer of all), through Your mercy I seek help.

items.ar: رواه الترمذيّ في «جامعه» (رقم: ٣٥٢٤) من حديث أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه
items.tr: Narrated by At-Tirmidhi in his Jami (no. ٣٥٢٤), from Anas ibn Malik, may Allah be pleased with him

items.ar: ضعّفه الترمذيّ بقوله: «حديث غريب»؛ لأنّ في إسناده يزيد الرَّقاشيّ، ولكن له شاهد من حديث ابن مسعود، فالحديث حسن بالشواهد
items.tr: At-Tirmidhi indicated its weakness by saying 'a gharib (uncommon) hadith,' because its chain contains Yazid ar-Raqashi. However, it has supporting evidence from a hadith of Ibn Masud, so it is hasan (good) through supporting narrations.

items.ar: الخبير
items.tr: Al-Khabir

items.ar: الخبير هو الذي بلغ علمه السرائر وما تخفيه الصدور، وأدرك دقائق الأمور وخفاياها.
items.tr: Al-Khabir knows secrets and what hearts conceal, comprehending the finest details of matters and their hidden aspects.

items.ar: فإذا أحاط بالخفيّ فعلمه بالظاهر أولى، ولا يغيب عنه من أمر العبد شيء.
items.tr: Since He encompasses what is hidden, His knowledge of what is apparent is all the more certain. Nothing concerning the servant is absent from Him.

items.ar: الذي أدرك علمُه السرائر، واطّلع على مكنون الضّمائر، وعلم خفيات البذور، ولطائف الأمور، ودقائق الذَّرّات
items.tr: His knowledge reaches secrets; He knows concealed thoughts, hidden seeds, subtle matters and the minutiae of particles.

items.ar: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
items.tr:
Does He who created not know,[1716] while He is the Subtle, the Aware?
[1716] Another accepted meaning is "Does He not know those whom He created...?"

items.ar: الخالق
items.tr: Al-Khaliq

items.ar: «الخالق» هو الذي أوجد الأشياء وأبدعها على غير مثال سابق، وقدّرها بعلمه وحكمته.
items.tr: Al-Khaliq brings things into being and originates them without a prior model, determining them by His knowledge and wisdom.

items.ar: وتفرده بالخلق وحده دليل على أنه وحده يستحق العبادة.
items.tr: His exclusive power to create is evidence that He alone deserves worship.

items.ar: والخلقُ يُطلق ويُرادُ به أمران: أحدهما: إيجاد الشيء وإبداعه على غير مثال سابق
items.tr: Creation is used to mean two things. The first is bringing something into being and originating it without a prior model.

items.ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (59:24):
He is Allāh, the Creator,[1666] the Producer,[1667] the Fashioner;[1668] to Him belong the best names.[1669] Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.[1670]
[1666] i.e., He who destined existence for His creation.
[1667] i.e., He who brings His creation into existence.
[1668] i.e., He who gives every creation its particular form.
[1669] Refer to the final paragraphs of the "Introduction" for a brief discussion of these attributes.
[1670] Refer to footnote in 6:18.

items.ar: الخلاق
items.tr: Al-Khallaq

items.ar: الخلَّاق صيغة مبالغة من الخالق، والخلق يقع على معنيين: إيجاد الشيء على غير مثال سابق، وتقديره.
items.tr: Al-Khallaq is an intensive form of Al-Khaliq. Creation has two meanings: bringing something into being without a prior model, and determining it.

items.ar: والإيجاد من العدم لا يقدر عليه أحد سوى الله، فهو المتفرّد بالخلق كلّه.
items.tr: No one other than Allah can bring something into being from nonexistence; all creation belongs exclusively to Him.

items.ar: أما الخلق الذي هو إبداع الشيء وإيجاده على غير مثال سابق فمتفرِّدٌ به ربُّ العالمين
items.tr: As for creation meaning originating something and bringing it into being without a prior model, this belongs exclusively to the Lord of the worlds.

items.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
items.tr: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

items.tr: Al-Hijr

items.ar: هذا الحديث منقول من المدخل الثاني لاسم «الخالق» الذي جُمع معه هذا الاسم في الكتاب: «الخالق، البارئ، المصور» (المطبوع ١١٣-١١٧)، ولذلك جُعل نطاق المدخل ١٠٨-١١٧ ليضم المدخلين معا.

items.ar: الرؤوف
items.tr: Ar-Rauf

items.ar: الرؤوفُ هو الذي وسِعت رأفتُه خلقَه؛ والرأفةُ أعلى معاني الرحمة وألطفُها.
items.tr: Ar-Rauf is the One whose compassion encompasses His creation. Compassion is the highest and gentlest form of mercy.

items.ar: ومن رأفته بعباده أنه خوَّفهم وزجرهم عن الغيّ لينجوا من عواقبه، ويسَّر لهم طرق الخير.
items.tr: His compassion for His servants includes warning and restraining them from wrongdoing so they escape its consequences, and making paths of good easy for them.

items.ar: وهذا يفيد أنَّ الله سبحانه مع شدَّة عقابه وعِظَم نكاله فإنه رؤوفٌ بالعباد، ومن رأفته بهم أنْ خوَّف العباد وزَجرهم عن الغيِّ والفساد، ليسلموا من مغبتها، ولينجوا من عواقبها
items.tr: This indicates that despite His severe punishment and tremendous chastisement, Allah, glorified is He, is compassionate toward His servants. His compassion includes warning them and restraining them from wrongdoing and corruption so they are safe from their effects and escape their consequences.

items.ar: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَٰنَكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (2:143):
And thus We have made you a median [i.e., just] community that you will be witnesses over the people and the Messenger will be a witness over you. And We did not make the qiblah which you used to face except that We might make evident who would follow the Messenger from who would turn back on his heels.[52] And indeed, it is difficult except for those whom Allāh has guided. And never would Allāh have caused you to lose your faith [i.e., your previous prayers]. Indeed Allāh is, to the people, Kind and Merciful.
[52] i.e., refuse.

items.ar: الرحمن
items.tr: Ar-Rahman

items.ar: «الرحمن» وصف لازم لله، أي أن الرحمة صفة ثابتة كاملة في ذاته.
items.tr: Ar-Rahman is an inseparable description of Allah, meaning that mercy is a firmly established, perfect attribute of His essence.

items.ar: ورحمته وسعت الخلق كلهم في الدنيا، مؤمنهم وكافرهم.
items.tr: His mercy encompasses all creation in this world, believers and disbelievers alike.

items.ar: والرحمن جاء على وزن (فعلان) الدال على الصفة الثابتة اللازمة الكاملة، أي: من صفته الرحمة
items.tr: Ar-Rahman follows the Arabic pattern falan, indicating a firmly established, inseparable and complete attribute: mercy is His attribute.

items.ar: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
items.tr:
The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.[832]
[832] i.e., having ascendancy over all creation. See footnotes to 2:19 and 7:54.

items.ar: إنّ لله مائةَ رحمة أنزل منها رحمةً واحدة بين الجنّ والإنس والبهائم والهوام، فبها يتعاطفون، وبها يتراحمون، وبها تعطف الوحش على ولدها. وأخَّر الله تسعاً وتسعين رحمة يرحم بها عباده يوم القيامة
items.tr: Allah has one hundred portions of mercy. He sent down one among jinn (unseen beings), humans, animals and creatures. Through it they show affection and mercy to one another, and wild animals show tenderness toward their young. Allah reserved ninety-nine portions of mercy with which to show mercy to His servants on the Day of Resurrection.

items.ar: متفق عليه: «صحيح البخاري» (رقم: ٦١٠٤)، و«صحيح مسلم» (رقم: ٢٧٥٢) ـ واللفظ له ـ عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه
items.tr: Agreed upon: Sahih al-Bukhari (no. ٦١٠٤) and Sahih Muslim (no. ٢٧٥٢), whose wording this is, from Abu Hurayrah, may Allah be pleased with him

items.ar: الرحيم
items.tr: Ar-Rahim

items.ar: «الرحيم» هو الذي تصل رحمته إلى المرحوم فعلا، لا صفة قائمة فقط.
items.tr: Ar-Rahim is the One whose mercy actually reaches its recipient, rather than being only an attribute of His essence.

items.ar: وله رحمة خاصة بالمؤمنين، بها يوفقهم ويثبتهم ويدخلهم الجنة.
items.tr: He has special mercy for believers, through which He grants them success, makes them steadfast and admits them to Paradise.

items.ar: والرحيم دالٌّ على تعديها للمرحوم، أي: من يرحم بالفعل
items.tr: Ar-Rahim indicates mercy extending to its recipient: the One who actually shows mercy.

items.ar: وَكَانَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًا
items.tr:
Full-verse context (33:43):
It is He who confers blessing upon you,[1204] and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful.
[1204] i.e., Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) cares for you and covers you with His mercy. An additional meaning is that He praises you in the presence of the angels.

items.tr: Al-Ahzab

items.ar: الرزاق
items.tr: Ar-Razzaq

items.ar: «الرزاق» هو المتكفل بأرزاق العباد، القائم على كل نفس بما يقيمها.
items.tr: Ar-Razzaq undertakes to provide for His servants, sustaining every soul with what maintains it.

items.ar: ولا رازق سواه، فلا يُطلب الرزق من غيره، ولا يشغل رزقُ الدنيا العبدَ عما خُلق له.
items.tr: No one provides besides Him. Provision must therefore not be sought from others, nor should worldly provision distract the servant from the purpose for which he was created.

items.ar: فالله سبحانه هو الرزَّاق أي: المتكفِّل بأرزاق العباد، القائم على كل نفس بما يقيمها من قوتها
items.tr: Allah, glorified is He, is Ar-Razzaq: He undertakes to provide for His servants and sustains every soul with the nourishment that maintains it.

items.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
items.tr:
Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider,[1548] the firm possessor of strength.
[1548] Providing everything required by His creations during their decreed existence. His provision includes guidance.

items.ar: الذاريات
items.tr: Adh-Dhariyat

items.ar: غلا السِّعر على عهد رسول الله ﷺ فقالوا: يا رسول الله! لو سعَّرتَ، فقال: إنَّ الله هو الخالق القابض الباسط الرازق المسعَّر، وإني لأرجو أن ألقى الله ولا يطلبني أحدٌ بمظلمة ظلمتها إيَّاه في دمٍ ولا مال
items.tr: Prices rose during the time of Allah's Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him. People said: Messenger of Allah, would you set prices? He said: Allah is Al-Khaliq (the Creator), Al-Qabid (the Withholder), Al-Basit (the Expander), Ar-Raziq (the Provider), the One who sets prices. I hope to meet Allah with no one claiming against me an injustice I committed against his blood or wealth.

items.ar: في «السنن» و«مسند الإمام أحمد» عن أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه: «سنن أبي داود» (رقم: ٣٤٥١)، والترمذي (رقم: ١٣١٤)، وابن ماجه (رقم: ٢٢٠٠)، و«مسند أحمد» (٣/ ١٥٦) وغيرهم بإسناد صحيح
items.tr: In the Sunan collections and Musnad al-Imam Ahmad, from Anas ibn Malik, may Allah be pleased with him: Sunan Abi Dawud (no. ٣٤٥١), At-Tirmidhi (no. ١٣١٤), Ibn Majah (no. ٢٢٠٠), Musnad Ahmad (٣/ ١٥٦) and others, with a sahih (authentic) chain

items.ar: الرقيب
items.tr: Ar-Raqib

items.ar: الرقيبُ هو المطَّلع على ما تُخفيه الصدور، القائم على كل نفس بما كسبت، الحافظ لخلقه المدبِّر لهم.
items.tr: Ar-Raqib knows what hearts conceal, watches every soul and what it earns, preserves His creation and governs them.

items.ar: وثمرةُ الإيمان به المراقبةُ: أن يستحضر العبد اطّلاع ربّه عليه في سرّه وعلانيته.
items.tr: The fruit of belief in Him is muraqabah (awareness of being watched by Allah): the servant keeps in mind that his Lord sees him in private and public.

items.ar: ومعنى الرقيب أي: المطَّلع على ما أكنَّتهُ الصدور، القائم على كل نفس بما كسبت، الذي حفظ المخلوقات وأجراها على أحسن نظام وأكمل تدبير
items.tr: Ar-Raqib means the One who knows what hearts conceal, watches every soul and what it earns, preserves created things and runs them with the finest order and most perfect governance.

items.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا
items.tr:
Full-verse context (4:1):
O mankind, fear your Lord, who created you from one soul and created from it its mate and dispersed from both of them many men and women. And fear Allāh, through whom[156] you ask one another,[157] and the wombs.[158] Indeed Allāh is ever,[159] over you, an Observer.[160]
[156] In whose name.
[157] i.e., request favors and demand rights.
[158] i.e., fear Allāh in regard to relations of kinship.
[159] When used in conjunction with Allāh's attributes, the word "ever" (occurring repeatedly throughout this sūrah and elsewhere, such as in sūrah al-Aḥzāb) is quite inadequate in imparting the sense of continuation expressed by the word "kāna" in Arabic, which indicates "always was, is, and always will be."
[160] Ever-present and taking account of everything.

items.ar: السلام
items.tr: As-Salam

items.ar: السلامُ هو السالم من كل عيب ونقص في ذاته وصفاته وأفعاله؛ فلا يلحقه موت ولا نوم ولا عجز ولا ظلم.
items.tr: As-Salam is free of every defect and deficiency in His essence, attributes and acts. Death, sleep, incapacity and injustice do not affect Him.

items.ar: وهو المسلِّم على رسله وأوليائه، وجنّتُه دار السلام، وأمانُ الخلق كلِّه منه وحده.
items.tr: He greets His messengers and devoted servants with peace; His Paradise is the abode of peace, and all creation's security comes from Him alone.

items.ar: ومعنى هذا الاسم الكريم أي: السلام من جميع العيوب والنقائص، لكماله في ذاته وصفاته وأفعاله، فهو جل وعلا السلام الحق بكل اعتبار، سلامٌ في ذاته عن كل عيب ونقص يتخيَّله وهم
items.tr: This noble name means being free of every defect and deficiency because of His perfection in His essence, attributes and acts. He, majestic and exalted is He, is truly As-Salam in every respect, free in His essence of every defect or deficiency the imagination might conceive.

items.ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (59:23):
He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign,[1658] the Pure,[1659] the Perfection,[1660] the Grantor of Security,[1661] the Overseer,[1662] the Exalted in Might,[1663] the Compeller,[1664] the Superior.[1665] Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
[1658] And owner of everything in existence.
[1659] i.e., transcendent above any aspect belonging to His creation. Also, the possessor and grantor of blessings.
[1660] Literally, "Free" from any imperfection. Also, "Peace" or "Soundness."
[1661] And safety, i.e., reassurance that His promise is always fulfilled. Also, He who bestows faith.
[1662] i.e., who observes, guards and protects. Also, "the Criterion."
[1663] Refer to footnote in 2:129.
[1664] Whose irresistible force is without limitation; the one above all things who compels the creation to be as He wills it. Also, "the Amender" or "the Rectifier" who repairs, restores, completes or sets something right once again, out of His mercy.
[1665] Supreme, complete and perfect in His essence, attributes and actions.

items.ar: السميع
items.tr: As-Sami

items.ar: السميع هو الذي يسمع كلّ الأصوات على اختلافها، سرَّها وجهرها، فلا يختلط عليه صوت بصوت ولا لغة بلغة.
items.tr: As-Sami hears every sound despite their differences, secret and public alike. No sound or language becomes confused with another for Him.

items.ar: ويأتي سمعه بمعنى الإجابة أيضًا، فمن آمن بأنّ ربّه سميع حفظ لسانه وأكثر من دعائه.
items.tr: His hearing also means answering. Whoever believes his Lord is As-Sami guards his tongue and supplicates to Him often.

items.ar: وسع سمعه الأصوات كلها، فلا تختلف عليه الأصوات ولا تشتبه، ولا يشغله منها سمع عن سمع، ولا يغلطه تنوع المسائل، ولا يبرمه كثرة السائلين
items.tr: His hearing encompasses every sound. Sounds neither confuse Him nor become indistinguishable; hearing one does not distract Him from hearing another. Varied requests do not cause Him error, and the multitude of petitioners does not weary Him.

items.ar: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
items.tr: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

items.ar: المجادلة
items.tr: Al-Mujadilah

items.ar: كنّا مع النبيّ ﷺ في سفر، فكنا إذا علونا كبَّرنا، فقال: اِرْبَعُوا على أنفسكم، فإنّكم لا تدعون أصمَّ ولا غائباً، ولكن تدعون سميعاً بصيراً قريباً
items.tr: We were traveling with the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. When we climbed, we declared Allah's greatness. He said: Be gentle with yourselves. You are not calling upon one who is deaf or absent, but upon One who hears, sees and is near.

items.ar: وفي «الصّحيحين» عن أبي موسى الأشعري رضي الله عنه: «صحيح البخاريّ» (رقم: ٦٣٨٤)، و«صحيح مسلم» (رقم: ٢٧٠٤)
items.tr: In the two Sahih collections, from Abu Musa al-Ashari, may Allah be pleased with him: Sahih al-Bukhari (no. ٦٣٨٤) and Sahih Muslim (no. ٢٧٠٤)

items.ar: الشاكر
items.tr: Ash-Shakir

items.ar: الشاكر
items.tr: Ash-Shakir

items.ar: الشاكرُ هو الذي يشكر عباده على طاعتهم، فيجزيهم على القليل أضعافًا مضاعفة.
items.tr: Ash-Shakir appreciates His servants' obedience and rewards their little many times over.

items.ar: ومن شكره أنه يثني على عبده بين ملائكته، ويخلف عليه خيرًا مما ترك من أجله.
items.tr: His appreciation includes praising His servant among His angels and replacing what the servant gives up for His sake with something better.

items.ar: وأن الشكور الشاكر: هو الذي لا يضيع عنده عمل عامل، بل يضاعف الأجر بلا حسبان، الذي يقبل اليسير من العمل، ويثيب عليه الثواب الكثير والعطاء الجزيل، والنوال الواسع
items.tr: Ash-Shakur, Ash-Shakir is the One with whom no worker's deed is lost. He multiplies reward without measure, accepts little work and grants abundant reward, generous giving and vast bounty for it.

items.ar: وَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (2:158):
Indeed, aṣ-Ṣafā and al-Marwah are among the symbols[55] of Allāh. So whoever makes ḥajj [pilgrimage] to the House or performs ʿumrah - there is no blame upon him for walking between them.[56] And whoever volunteers good - then indeed, Allāh is Appreciative[57] and Knowing.
[55] Places designated for the rites of ḥajj and ʿumrah.
[56] Some believers had previously feared that this might be a pagan practice, so Allāh confirms that saʿī is among the rites of His religion.
[57] i.e., He rewards generously.

items.ar: الشكور
items.tr: Ash-Shakur

items.ar: الشكورُ هو الذي لا يضيع عنده عمل عامل؛ يقبل اليسير ويضاعف عليه الأجر بلا حساب.
items.tr: Ash-Shakur is the One with whom no worker's deed is lost. He accepts little and multiplies its reward without measure.

items.ar: وهو الذي وفّق العبد للعمل ثم شكره عليه، فلا يضيع أجر محسن ولا يعذّب غير مسيء.
items.tr: He enables the servant to act, then appreciates his deed. He neither lets the reward of a doer of good be lost nor punishes someone who has not done wrong.

items.ar: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
items.tr:
That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.[1250]
[1250] i.e., He gives much in return for little and multiplies rewards.

items.ar: الشهيد
items.tr: Ash-Shahid

items.ar: الشهيدُ هو المطَّلع على كل شيء، لا يخفى عليه شيء؛ سمع الأصوات كلَّها، وأبصر الموجودات كلَّها.
items.tr: Ash-Shahid knows everything; nothing is hidden from Him. He hears every sound and sees everything that exists.

items.ar: وهو الذي يشهد لعباده وعليهم بما عملوا، فمن أيقن بذلك حفظ قوله وعمله.
items.tr: He testifies for and against His servants concerning their deeds. Whoever is certain of this guards his words and actions.

items.ar: ومعنى الشَّهيد أي: المطَّلع على كلِّ شيءٍ الذي لا يخفى عليه شيءٌ، سمع جميع الأصوات خفيها وجليها، وأبصر جميع الموجودات دقيقها وجليلها، صغيرها وكبيرها
items.tr: Ash-Shahid means the One who knows everything and from whom nothing is hidden. He hears every sound, hidden and apparent, and sees all existing things, minute and immense, small and large.

items.ar: وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (85:9):
To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.[1897]
[1897] See footnote to 4:79.

items.ar: الصمد
items.tr: As-Samad

items.ar: «الصمد» هو السيد العظيم الذي كمل في صفاته كلها.
items.tr: As-Samad is the supreme Master, perfect in all His attributes.

items.ar: وهو الذي تقصده الخلائق في حاجاتها وشدائدها، فلا ملجأ منه إلا إليه.
items.tr: All creatures turn to Him in their needs and hardships. There is no refuge from Him except to Him.

items.ar: و«الصَّمد» معناه: السّيد العظيم الذي قد كمل في علمه وحكمته وحلمه وقدرته وعزته وعظمته وجميع صفاته، فهو واسع الصفات عظيمُها، الذي صمدت إليه جميع المخلوقات
items.tr: As-Samad means the supreme Master, perfect in His knowledge, wisdom, forbearance, power, might, greatness and all His attributes. His attributes are vast and immense, and all created things turn to Him.

items.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
items.tr:
Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.[2012]
[2012] He who is absolute, perfect, complete, essential, self-sufficient and sufficient to meet the needs of all creation; the one eternally and constantly required and sought, depended upon by all existence and to whom all matters will ultimately return.

items.ar: أيعجِز أحدكم أن يقرأ ثلث القرآن في ليلة؟! فشق ذلك عليهم وقالوا: أيُّنا يُطيق ذلك يا رسول الله؟! فقال: الله الواحد الصَّمد ثلث القرآن
items.tr: Is any of you unable to read a third of the Quran in one night? They found that difficult and said: Which of us can manage that, Messenger of Allah? He said: Allah al-Wahid as-Samad is a third of the Quran.

items.ar: في «صحيح البخاري» (رقم: ٤٧٢٧) عن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه
items.tr: In Sahih al-Bukhari (no. ٤٧٢٧), from Abu Said al-Khudri, may Allah be pleased with him

items.ar: العالم
items.tr: Al-Alim

items.ar: العالِمُ اسمٌ عدَّه الشيخ فيما جمعه بالتتبُّع من أسماء الله في كتاب الله تعالى.
items.tr: Al-Alim is a name the shaykh included among the names of Allah he collected through examination of Allah Most High's Book.

items.ar: ولم يذكر له في هذا الموضع شرحًا ولا موضعًا بعينه من القرآن؛ فليس في الكتاب أكثر من إثباته في العدّ.
items.tr: He did not explain it here or identify a particular Quranic occurrence. The book does no more than affirm its inclusion in the list.

items.ar: عدَّ الشيخُ هذا الاسمَ في التسعة والتسعين ولم يشرح معناه ولم يذكر له موضعًا بعينه.
items.tr: The shaykh counted this name among the ninety-nine without explaining its meaning or identifying a particular occurrence.

items.ar: العزيز
items.tr: Al-Aziz

items.ar: العزيزُ له العزّة بجميع معانيها: عزّةُ القوّة، وعزّةُ الامتناع، وعزّةُ القهر والغلبة.
items.tr: Al-Aziz possesses might in all its meanings: strength, invulnerability, and subduing and overcoming.

items.ar: فلا يغلبه غالب، ولا يبلغ العبادُ ضرَّه ولا نفعَه، والكائناتُ كلُّها مقهورة لعظمته.
items.tr: None can overcome Him. His servants cannot harm or benefit Him, and all beings are subdued by His greatness.

items.ar: أي: الذي له العزة بجميع معانيها، وهي ترجع إلى ثلاثة معانٍ كلها ثابتة لله عز وجل على التمام والكمال
items.tr: That is, He possesses might in all its meanings. They return to three meanings, all fully and perfectly established for Allah, mighty and majestic is He.

items.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا
items.tr:
Full-verse context (10:65):
And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to Allāh entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

items.ar: العظيم
items.tr: Al-Azim

items.ar: العظيم هو الذي له جميع معاني العظمة والجلال: القوّة والعزّة وكمال القدرة وسعة العلم.
items.tr: Al-Azim possesses every meaning of greatness and majesty: strength, might, perfect power and vast knowledge.

items.ar: وعظمته لا تحيط بها العقول ولا يبلغ العباد كنهها، فحقّها أن يُعظَّم بالقلب واللسان والعمل.
items.tr: Minds cannot encompass His greatness or servants comprehend its reality. Its due is reverence through the heart, tongue and deeds.

items.ar: أحدهما: يرجع إلى صفاته سبحانه، وأنَّ له جميع معاني العظمة والجلال، كالقوّة، والعزّة، وكمال القدرة، وسعة العلم، وكمال المجد، وغيرها من أوصاف العظمة والكبرياء
items.tr: One relates to His attributes, glorified is He, and His possessing every meaning of greatness and majesty, such as strength, might, perfect power, vast knowledge, perfect glory and other attributes of greatness and supreme grandeur.

items.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
items.tr: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

items.ar: الحاقة
items.tr: Al-Haqqah

items.ar: الكبرياء ردائي، والعظمة إزاري، فمن نازعني واحداً منها قذفته في النّار
items.tr: Supreme grandeur is My cloak and greatness is My lower garment. Whoever contests either with Me, I will cast into the Fire.

items.ar: رواه أحمد وأبو داود من حديث أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه: «مسند الإمام أحمد» (٢/٢٤٨)، و«سنن أبي داود» (رقم: ٤٠٩٠) وغيرهما

items.ar: وإسناده حسن
items.tr: Its chain is hasan (good).

items.ar: العفو
items.tr: Al-Afuww

items.ar: العفو
items.tr: Al-Afuww

items.ar: العفوّ هو الذي يمحو سيّئات عباده ويتجاوز عن معاصيهم.
items.tr: Al-Afuww erases His servants' evil deeds and overlooks their disobedience.

items.ar: والعفو أبلغ من المغفرة؛ لأنّ المغفرة سترٌ للذنب، والعفو محوٌ له.
items.tr: Afw (pardon) is more emphatic than maghfirah (forgiveness), because forgiveness conceals a sin while pardon erases it.

items.ar: هو الذي يمحو السيِّئات، ويتجاوز عن المعاصي، وهو قريب من الغفور، ولكنه أبلغ منه؛ فإنَّ الغفران ينبئ عن السِّتر، والعفو ينبئ عن المحو، والمحو أبلغ من السِّتر
items.tr: He erases evil deeds and overlooks disobedience. This is close to Al-Ghafur but more emphatic: forgiveness indicates concealment, while pardon indicates erasure, and erasure is more emphatic than concealment.

items.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (22:60):
That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allāh will surely aid him. Indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.[937]
[937] In spite of His ability to take vengeance. The statement contains a suggestion that the believers pardon as well.

items.tr: Al-Hajj

items.ar: ليس أحدٌ ـ أو ليس شيء ـ أصبرَ على أذى سَمِعَه من الله، إنّهم ليدعون له ولداً، وإنه ليعافيهم ويرزقهم
items.tr: No one, or nothing, is more patient than Allah with offensive words heard. They attribute a child to Him, yet He grants them well-being and provides for them.

items.ar: في «الصحيحين» من حديث أبي موسى الأشعري رضي الله عنه: «صحيح البخاري» (رقم: ٦٠٩٩)، و«صحيح مسلم» (رقم: ٢٨٠٤)

items.ar: العليم
items.tr: Al-Aleem

items.ar: العليم هو الذي أحاط علمه بكلّ شيء: ظاهره وباطنه، وسرّه وعلنه، وماضيه وحاضره ومستقبله.
items.tr: Al-Alim is the One whose knowledge encompasses everything: its outward and inward aspects, secrets and publicity, past, present and future.

items.ar: فلا تخفى عليه خافية، ومن استحضر ذلك استحيا من ربّه فأصلح عمله.
items.tr: Nothing hidden is concealed from Him. Whoever keeps this in mind feels shame before his Lord and rectifies his deeds.

items.ar: الذي أحاط علمه بالظواهر والبواطن والإسرار والإعلان، وبالعالم العلوي والسفلي، بالماضي والحاضر والمستقبل، فلا يخفى عليه شيء من الأشياء، علم ما كان وما سيكون، وما لم يكن أن لو كان كيف يكون، أحاط بكل شيء علمًا، وأحصى كل شيء عددًا
items.tr: His knowledge encompasses outward and inward things, secrecy and publicity, the upper and lower worlds, and past, present and future. Nothing is hidden from Him. He knows what was and what will be, and how what did not happen would be if it happened. His knowledge encompasses everything, and He has counted everything.

items.ar: يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (30:54):
Allāh is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.

items.ar: الروم
items.tr: Ar-Rum

items.ar: العليّ هو الذي علا على كلّ شيء: علوّ ذاتٍ فوق عرشه، وعلوّ قدرٍ في صفاته، وعلوّ قهرٍ على خلقه.
items.tr: Al-Ali is exalted above everything: high in His essence above His Throne, high in rank in His attributes, and high in His subduing of His creation.

items.ar: فليس فوقه شيء، ولا تشبه صفاته صفة أحد، والخلق كلّهم تحت تدبيره.
items.tr: Nothing is above Him. His attributes resemble no one's attributes, and all creation is under His governance.

items.ar: وهذه الأسماء تدلُّ على علوه المطلق بجميع الوجوه والاعتبارات: فهو العليّ علو ذات، قد استوى على العرش، وعلا على جميع الكائنات، وباينها
items.tr: These names indicate His absolute highness in every respect and consideration. He is high in His essence, has risen above the Throne, is above all beings and is distinct from them.

items.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (2:255):
Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living,[98] the Self-Sustaining.[99] Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them,[100] and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī[101] extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High,[102] the Most Great.[103]
[98] Whose life is perfect, complete and eternal, without beginning or end, and through whom all created life originated and continues.
[99] Dependent on none for His existence while being the sustainer and administrator of all created existence.
[100] Allāh's knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.
[101] Chair or footstool. It is not to be confused with al-ʿArsh (the Throne) , which is infinitely higher and greater than al-Kursī.
[102] Above all of His creations and superior to them in essence, rank and position.
[103] Whose greatness is unlimited, beyond description or imagination.

items.ar: الغفار
items.tr: Al-Ghaffar

items.ar: الغفّار صيغة مبالغة من الغفور، تدلّ على كثرة مغفرته وتكرارها.
items.tr: Al-Ghaffar is an intensive form of Al-Ghafur, indicating the abundance and repetition of His forgiveness.

items.ar: وأبواب مغفرته مفتوحة لا تُغلق، وهي موعودة لمن تاب وآمن وعمل صالحًا.
items.tr: The doors of His forgiveness are open and never close. It is promised to those who repent, believe and do righteous deeds.

items.ar: وأبواب عفوه وغفرانه مفتوحة، ولم يزل ولا يزال عفوًّا غفورًا، وقد وعد بالمغفرة والعفو لمن أتى بأسبابها
items.tr: The doors of His pardon and forgiveness are open. He has always been and will always be pardoning and forgiving, and has promised forgiveness and pardon to those who undertake their means.

items.ar: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
items.tr: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.

items.ar: أذنب عبدٌ ذنباً، فقال: اللهمّ اغفر لي ذنبي، فقال تبارك وتعالى: أذنب عبدي ذنباً، فعلم أنّ له ربًّا يغفر الذنب، ويأخذُ بالذنب. ثم عاد فأذنب، فقال: أي ربِّ اغفر لي ذنبي، فقال تبارك وتعالى: عبدي أذنب ذنباً فعلم أنّ له ربًّا يغفر الذنب ويأخذ بالذنب. ثم عاد فأذنب فقال: أي ربّ اغفر لي ذنبي، فقال تبارك وتعالى: أذنب عبدي ذنباً فعلم أنّ له ربًّا يغفر الذنب ويأخذ بالذنب، اعمل ما شئتَ فقد غفرتُ لك
items.tr: A servant committed a sin and said: O Allah, forgive my sin. He, blessed and exalted is He, said: My servant sinned and knew that he has a Lord who forgives sin and punishes for sin. Then he sinned again and said: My Lord, forgive my sin. He, blessed and exalted is He, said: My servant sinned and knew that he has a Lord who forgives sin and punishes for sin. Then he sinned again and said: My Lord, forgive my sin. He, blessed and exalted is He, said: My servant sinned and knew that he has a Lord who forgives sin and punishes for sin. Do whatever you will, for I have forgiven you.

items.ar: رواه البخاري ومسلم في «صحيحيهما» عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه: «صحيح البخاري» (رقم: ٧٥٠٧)، و«صحيح مسلم» (رقم: ٢٧٥٨) واللفظ له
items.tr: Narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim in their Sahih collections, from Abu Hurayrah, may Allah be pleased with him: Sahih al-Bukhari (no. ٧٥٠٧) and Sahih Muslim (no. ٢٧٥٨), whose wording this is

items.ar: الغفور
items.tr: Al-Ghafur

items.ar: الغفور
items.tr: Al-Ghafur

items.ar: الغفور هو الذي يستر ذنوب عباده فلا يفضحهم بها.
items.tr: Al-Ghafur conceals His servants' sins and does not expose them through them.

items.ar: ولا يعظم عليه ذنبٌ أن يغفره مهما بلغ، ما دام صاحبه طالبًا عفوه راجيًا مغفرته.
items.tr: No sin, however immense, is too great for Him to forgive, so long as its perpetrator seeks His pardon and hopes for His forgiveness.

items.ar: فهو سبحانه عفو غفور لا يتعاظمه أن يغفره ذنب مهما بلغ الذنب وعظم الجرم، والعبد على خير عظيم ما دام طالباً عفو ربِّه، راجياً غفرانه
items.tr: He, glorified is He, is pardoning and forgiving. No sin, however great, or offense, however immense, is too great for Him to forgive. The servant enjoys tremendous good as long as he seeks his Lord's pardon and hopes for His forgiveness.

items.ar: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
items.tr:
Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins.[1354] Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
[1354] For those who repent and correct themselves.

items.tr: Az-Zumar

items.ar: الغني
items.tr: Al-Ghani

items.ar: الغنيُّ هو الغنيُّ بذاته غنًى تامًّا مطلقًا من كل وجه؛ لا يحتاج إلى أحد، والخلق كلُّهم مفتقرون إليه.
items.tr: Al-Ghani is completely and absolutely self-sufficient in His essence in every respect. He needs no one, while all creation needs Him.

items.ar: لا تنفعه طاعة الطائعين ولا تضرّه معصية العاصين؛ ومن عرف غنى ربّه عرف فقر نفسه.
items.tr: The obedience of the obedient does not benefit Him, nor does the disobedience of the disobedient harm Him. Whoever knows his Lord's self-sufficiency knows his own need.

items.ar: فهو تبارك وتعالى الغني بذاته، الذي له الغنى التام المطلق من جميع الوجوه والاعتبارات، لكماله وكمال صفاته التي لا يتطرق إليها نقص بوجه من الوجوه
items.tr: He, blessed and exalted is He, is self-sufficient in His essence, possessing complete and absolute self-sufficiency in every respect and consideration, because of His perfection and His attributes' perfection, which no deficiency can affect in any way.

items.ar: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (6:133):
And your Lord is the Free of need, the possessor of mercy. If He wills, He can do away with you and give succession after you to whomever He wills, just as He produced you from the descendants of another people.

items.ar: الفتاح
items.tr: Al-Fattah

items.ar: الفتّاح هو الذي يحكم بين عباده بما يشاء، لا رادَّ لحكمه ولا معقّب لقضائه.
items.tr: Al-Fattah judges between His servants as He wills. None can reject His judgment or overturn His decree.

items.ar: وهو الذي يفتح لعباده أبواب الرحمة والرزق والعلم، فيفتح على من يشاء ما أُغلق عن غيره.
items.tr: He opens the doors of mercy, provision and knowledge for His servants, opening for whomever He wills what is closed to others.

items.ar: الذي يحكم بين عباده بما يشاء، ويقضي فيهم بما يريد، ويمنّ على من يشاء منهم بما يشاء، لا راد لحكمه، ولا معقب لقضائه وأمره
items.tr: He judges between His servants as He wills, decrees for them what He wants and favors whomever He wills among them with whatever He wills. None can reject His judgment or overturn His decree and command.

items.ar: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
items.tr:
Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."[1232]
[1232] Literally, "Opener," i.e., He who decides and lays open all matters in truth and justice and who opens the way to victory, success, relief, knowledge and understanding.

items.tr: When one of you enters the mosque, let him say: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy. When he leaves, let him say: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

items.ar: القادرُ هو الذي كلُّ شيء طوعُ أمره وتحت تدبيره؛ فما شاء كان، وما لم يشأ لم يكن.
items.tr: Al-Qadir is the One to whose command everything submits and under whose governance everything falls. What He wills happens, and what He does not will does not happen.

items.ar: وبقدرته يقلّب القلوب ويصرّفها على ما يشاء، فيهدي من يشاء ويضلّ من يشاء.
items.tr: By His power He turns hearts and directs them as He wills, guiding whomever He wills and leading astray whomever He wills.

items.ar: وجميعها تدل على ثبوت القدرة صفة لله، وأنه سبحانه كامل القدرة، فبقدرته أوجد الموجودات، وبقدرته دبرها، وبقدرته سواها وأحكمها، وبقدرته يحيي ويميت
items.tr: All of them affirm power as an attribute of Allah and His perfect power. Through His power He brought beings into existence, governs them, fashions them precisely, gives life and causes death.

items.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلْقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (6:65):
Say, "He is the [one] Able to send upon you affliction from above you or from beneath your feet or to confuse you [so you become] sects[314] and make you taste the violence of one another." Look how We diversify the signs that they might understand.
[314] Following your own inclinations rather than the truth, biased and hostile toward each other.

items.ar: القاهرُ هو الذي قهر جميع الكائنات، وذلَّت له المخلوقات، ودانت لقدرته ومشيئته.
items.tr: Al-Qahir subdues all beings. Created things humble themselves to Him and submit to His power and will.

items.ar: فلا يحدث حادثٌ ولا يسكن ساكنٌ إلا بإذنه؛ ما شاء كان وما لم يشأ لم يكن.
items.tr: No event occurs and nothing remains still except by His permission. What He wills happens, and what He does not will does not happen.

items.ar: والقهّار صيغة مبالغة من القاهر، ومعناهما: الذي قهر جميع الكائنات وذلَّت له جميع المخلوقات، ودانت لقدرته ومشيئته مواد وعناصر العالم العلوي والسفلي
items.tr: Al-Qahhar is an intensive form of Al-Qahir. Both mean the One who subdues all beings, before whom all created things humble themselves, and to whose power and will the substances and elements of the upper and lower worlds submit.

items.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
items.tr:
And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise,[296] the Aware.[297]
[296] Whose wisdom includes precise, perfect and absolute knowledge of all realities and outcomes, according to which He decrees and causes circumstances and occurrences.
[297] Fully acquainted and familiar with every hidden thought, intent and condition of His servants.

items.ar: القدُّوسُ هو المنزَّه عن كل عيب ونقص، المتبرّئ من كل ما يضادّ كماله وعظمته.
items.tr: Al-Quddus is free of every defect and deficiency, clear of everything opposing His perfection and greatness.

items.ar: فلا سِنَة ولا نوم ولا لغوب، ولا والد ولا ولد، ولا شبيه له في خلقه ولا نظير.
items.tr: Neither drowsiness, sleep nor fatigue affects Him. He has neither parent nor child, and no likeness or counterpart among His creation.

items.ar: و«السُّبُّوح القُدُّوس» اسمان عظيمان دالَّان على تنزيه الله عن النقائص والعيوب، وتبرئته عن كل ما يضاد وينافي كماله وعظمته، كالسِّنَة والنوم واللَّغوب والوالد والولد وغيرها
items.tr: As-Subbuh and Al-Quddus are two great names indicating Allah's freedom from deficiencies and defects, and His being clear of everything opposing and contradicting His perfection and greatness, such as drowsiness, sleep, fatigue, parenthood, offspring and other things.

items.ar: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْمَلِكِ ٱلْقُدُّوسِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

items.tr: Al-Qadir possesses perfect power. Through His power He brings beings into existence, governs and perfects them, gives life, causes death and resurrects.

items.tr: When He wills something, He commands it to be and it comes into being. Nothing exceeds His ability, and none of His creation escapes Him.

items.ar: القريب
items.tr: Al-Qarib

items.ar: القريبُ قريبٌ من عباده العابدين الداعين قربًا خاصًّا لا تُدرك له حقيقة.
items.tr: Al-Qarib is near His worshiping, supplicating servants with a special nearness whose reality cannot be comprehended.

items.ar: وتُعرف آثارُه في لطفه بهم وتوفيقه لهم وإجابته لدعائهم؛ فهو يسمع نداءهم وهو معهم.
items.tr: Its effects are known through His kindness to them, granting them success and answering their supplications. He hears their calls and is with them.

items.ar: وقرب الله الذي تدلُّ عليه هذه الآيات هو قربٌ خاصٌّ من العابدين المحبِّين والدّاعين المستجيبين، قربٌ لا يدرك له حقيقة، وإنما تُعلَمُ آثاره من لطفه بهم، وتوفيقه لهم، وعنايته بهم
items.tr: Allah's nearness indicated by these ayat (verses) is a special nearness to loving worshipers and responsive supplicants. Its reality cannot be comprehended; its effects are known through His kindness to them, granting them success and caring for them.

items.ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (2:186):
And when My servants ask you, [O Muḥammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided.

items.ar: القوي
items.tr: Al-Qawi

items.ar: القويُّ هو الذي لا يعجزه شيء، ولا يغلبه غالب، ولا يُردُّ قضاؤه؛ فالقوّة كلُّها لله وحده.
items.tr: Al-Qawi is the One whom nothing exceeds in ability, whom none overcomes and whose decree cannot be rejected. All strength belongs to Allah alone.

items.ar: فمن آمن بهذا الاسم لم يطلب النصر ولا العزّ من سواه، وتبرّأ من حوله وقوّته.
items.tr: Whoever believes in this name seeks neither victory nor honor from others and disclaims reliance on his own power and strength.

items.ar: ومعنى «القويّ» أي: الذي لا يعجزه شيء، ولا يغلبه غالب، ولا يرد قضاءه راد، ينفذ أمره ويمضي قضاؤه في خلقه، يعز من يشاء، ويذل من يشاء، وينصر من يشاء، ويخذل من يشاء
items.tr: Al-Qawi means the One whom nothing exceeds in ability, whom none overcomes and whose decree none rejects. His command takes effect and His decree concerning His creation proceeds. He honors whom He wills, humiliates whom He wills, grants victory to whom He wills and forsakes whom He wills.

items.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ

So when Our command came, We saved Ṣāliḥ and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and [saved them] from the disgrace of that day.[561] Indeed, it is your Lord who is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
[561] The day of Thamūd's destruction.

items.tr: Abdullah ibn Qays, say: There is no power or strength except through Allah, for it is among the treasures of Paradise.

items.ar: القهّارُ صيغةُ مبالغة من القاهر؛ فهو الذي انقادت جميع الأشياء لقهره وسلطانه.
items.tr: Al-Qahhar is an intensive form of Al-Qahir. All things submit to His subduing power and authority.

items.ar: ولا يكون القهّارُ إلا واحدًا؛ فاسمُه هذا من أظهر دلائل توحيده وبطلان الشرك.
items.tr: Al-Qahhar can only be One. This name is thus among the clearest proofs of His oneness and the invalidity of shirk (associating partners with Allah).

items.ar: فالواحد لا يكون إلا قهَّاراً، والقهَّار لا يكون إلَّا واحداً، وذلك ولا ريب ينفي الشركة ويبطل اتخاذ الأنداد
items.tr: The One can only be the All-Subduing, and the All-Subduing can only be One. This undoubtedly negates partnership and invalidates taking rivals.

items.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّٰرُ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (13:16):
Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allāh." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allāh partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?"[635] Say, "Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing."[636]
[635] The obvious conclusion is that the claimed partners, having no ability to create, cannot be compared to Allāh in any way.
[636] Refer to footnotes in 12:39.

items.ar: الكبير هو الذي لا شيء أكبر منه ولا أعظم، وله الكبرياء وحده.
items.tr: Al-Kabir is the One than whom nothing is greater or more immense. Supreme grandeur belongs to Him alone.

items.ar: ولهذا كان «الله أكبر» أبلغ كلمة في التعظيم، وشُرع التكبير في الصلاة والأذان والحجّ.
items.tr: Thus, 'Allahu akbar (Allah is greatest)' is the most emphatic expression of reverence, and takbir (declaring Allah's greatness) is prescribed in salah (prayer), the adhan (call to prayer) and Hajj (pilgrimage).

items.ar: وبه يتبيّن معنى (الله أكبر) أي من كلِّ شيء، فلا شيء أكبر ولا أعظم منه، ولهذا يقال: إنَّ أبلغ لفظة للعرب في معنى التّعظيم والإجلال هي: الله أكبر
items.tr: This makes clear the meaning of 'Allahu akbar': greater than everything. Nothing is greater or more immense than Him. Thus it is said that the Arabs' most emphatic expression of reverence and exaltation is 'Allahu akbar (Allah is greatest).'

items.ar: فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (40:12):
[They will be told], "That is because, when Allāh was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allāh, the Most High, the Grand."

items.ar: الكريمُ هو الكثير الخير العظيم النفع، وهو من كل شيء أحسنُه وأفضلُه.
items.tr: Al-Karim abounds in good and immense benefit. Of anything described as karim, it denotes its finest and best.

items.ar: يعطي بلا عوض ولا سؤال، ويتجاوز عن الذنوب، ويستحيي أن يردَّ من مدّ إليه يديه.
items.tr: He gives without compensation or request, overlooks sins and is too generous to turn away someone who raises his hands to Him.

items.ar: و«الكريم»: هو الكثير الخير العظيم النفع، وهو مِن كلِّ شيء أحسنُه وأفضلُه، والله سبحانه وصف نفسه بالكرم كما في الآيات المتقدمة
items.tr: Al-Karim abounds in good and immense benefit. Of anything described as karim, it denotes its finest and best. Allah, glorified is He, described Himself with karam (nobility and generosity), as in the preceding ayat (verses).

items.ar: الانفطار
items.tr: Al-Infitar

items.ar: اللطيف
items.tr: Al-Latif

items.ar: اللطيف له معنيان: علمٌ دقيق يبلغ أخفى الأشياء، ولطفٌ يوصل إلى العبد مصالحه من حيث لا يشعر.
items.tr: Al-Latif has two meanings: precise knowledge reaching the most hidden things, and kindness that brings a servant what benefits him without his awareness.

items.ar: فقد يسوق إليه الخير من طريق لم يخترها، وقد يقدّر عليه ما يكره ويكون فيه صلاحه.
items.tr: He may bring him good through a path he did not choose and decree for him something he dislikes which contains his well-being.

items.ar: الذي يوصل إلى عباده وأوليائه مصالحهم بلطفه وإحسانه من طرق لا يشعرون بها
items.tr: Through His kindness and beneficence, He brings His servants and devoted ones what benefits them by ways they do not perceive.

items.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
items.tr:
Allāh is Subtle[1419] with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
[1419] See footnote in 12:100.

items.tr: Ash-Shura

items.ar: المؤمن
items.tr: Al-Mumin

items.ar: المؤمنُ هو المصدِّق؛ شهد لنفسه بالتوحيد، وصدَّق عباده الشاهدين له به، وأقام البراهين على صدق رسله.
items.tr: Al-Mumin is the Confirmer: He testifies to His own oneness, confirms His servants who testify to it, and establishes proofs of His messengers' truthfulness.

items.ar: وهو الذي يؤمِّن الخائفين ويعطيهم الأمان؛ فأمنُ العباد وأمنُ البلاد بيده سبحانه.
items.tr: He grants security to the fearful. The security of servants and lands is in His hand, glorified is He.

items.ar: والإيمان يرجع معناه إلى التّصديق والإقرار، وما يقتضيه ذلك من الإرشاد وتصديق الصادقين، وإقامة البراهين على صدقهم، فهو تعالى المؤمن الذي هو كما أثنى على نفسه، وفوق ما يثني عليه عباده
items.tr: Iman here means affirmation and acknowledgment, with the guidance, confirmation of the truthful and establishment of proofs of their truthfulness that this entails. He Most High is Al-Mumin, who is as He has praised Himself and above His servants' praise of Him.

items.ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ
items.tr:
Full-verse context (59:23):
He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign,[1658] the Pure,[1659] the Perfection,[1660] the Grantor of Security,[1661] the Overseer,[1662] the Exalted in Might,[1663] the Compeller,[1664] the Superior.[1665] Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
[1658] And owner of everything in existence.
[1659] i.e., transcendent above any aspect belonging to His creation. Also, the possessor and grantor of blessings.
[1660] Literally, "Free" from any imperfection. Also, "Peace" or "Soundness."
[1661] And safety, i.e., reassurance that His promise is always fulfilled. Also, He who bestows faith.
[1662] i.e., who observes, guards and protects. Also, "the Criterion."
[1663] Refer to footnote in 2:129.
[1664] Whose irresistible force is without limitation; the one above all things who compels the creation to be as He wills it. Also, "the Amender" or "the Rectifier" who repairs, restores, completes or sets something right once again, out of His mercy.
[1665] Supreme, complete and perfect in His essence, attributes and actions.

items.ar: إذا قال العبد: لا إله إلَّا الله، والله أكبر، قال: يقول الله تبارك وتعالى: صدق عبدي، لا إله إلا أنا، وأنا أكبر، وإذا قال: لا إله إلَّا الله وحده، قال: صدق عبدي، لا إله إلَّا أنا وحدي، وإذا قال: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، قال: صدق عبدي لا إله إلا أنا لا شريك لي، وإذا قال: لا إله إلَّا الله له الملك وله الحمد، قال: صدق عبدي، لا إله إلَّا أنا لي الملك ولي الحمد، وإذا قال: لا إله إلَّا الله ولا حول ولا قوة إلَّا بالله، قال: صدق عبدي لا إله إلَّا أنا ولا حول ولا قوة إلَّا بي
items.tr: When the servant says, 'None is worthy of worship except Allah, and Allah is greatest,' Allah, blessed and exalted is He, says: 'My servant has spoken the truth. None is worthy of worship except Me, and I am greatest.' When he says, 'None is worthy of worship except Allah alone,' He says: 'My servant has spoken the truth. None is worthy of worship except Me alone.' When he says, 'None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner,' He says: 'My servant has spoken the truth. None is worthy of worship except Me; I have no partner.' When he says, 'None is worthy of worship except Allah; His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise,' He says: 'My servant has spoken the truth. None is worthy of worship except Me; Mine is the dominion and to Me belongs all praise.' When he says, 'None is worthy of worship except Allah; there is no power or strength except through Allah,' He says: 'My servant has spoken the truth. None is worthy of worship except Me; there is no power or strength except through Me.'

items.ar: رواه الترمذي وابن ماجه وغيرهما عن أبي إسحاق، عن الأغر أبي مسلم، أنه شهد على أبي هريرة وأبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنهما: «جامع الترمذي» (رقم: ٣٤٣٠)، و«سنن ابن ماجه» (رقم: ٣٧٩٤)
items.tr: Narrated by At-Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah and others, from Abu Ishaq, from Al-Agharr Abu Muslim, who bore witness concerning Abu Hurayrah and Abu Said al-Khudri, may Allah be pleased with them both: Jami at-Tirmidhi (no. ٣٤٣٠) and Sunan Ibn Majah (no. ٣٧٩٤)

items.ar: وحسنه الترمذي. وانظر: «السلسلة الصحيحة» (رقم: ١٣٩١)
items.tr: At-Tirmidhi graded it hasan (good). See As-Silsilah as-Sahihah (no. ١٣٩١).

items.ar: أُدخل هذا الحديث بتصريح الشيخ في المطبوع ٢١٣ أنه من دلائل اسم «المؤمن»، لا بجريان القاعدة عليه؛ فإن جذر (أ م ن) لا يرد في الحديث ومداره على (ص د ق).
items.tr: This hadith was included because the shaykh explicitly stated on printed page ٢١٣ that it is evidence for the name Al-Mumin, rather than because the general rule applies to it. The root (a-m-n) does not occur in the hadith; its focus is (s-d-q), truthfulness.

items.ar: المتعال هو المترفّع عن كلّ نقص، الذي قهر كلّ شيء ودانت له الكائنات بأسرها.
items.tr: Al-Mutaal is exalted above every deficiency, subdues everything, and has all beings submitting to Him.

items.ar: فنواصي الخلق بيده، لا يتحرّك متحرّك ولا يسكن ساكن إلّا بإذنه.
items.tr: Creation's forelocks are in His hand. Nothing moves or remains still except by His permission.

items.ar: فجميع الخلق نواصيهم بيده، فلا يتحرّك منهم متحرِّك، ولا يسكن ساكن إلاّ بإذنه، وما شاء كان وما لم يشأ لم يكن
items.tr: All creation's forelocks are in His hand. None moves or remains still except by His permission. What He wills happens, and what He does not will does not happen.

items.ar: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ٱلْمُتَعَالِ
items.tr: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
